data_collected.description: App interactions with the local MUSE gateway (chat prompts, task requests, approval decisions) are sent to the user's local muse gateway over loopback/LAN. No data leaves the device or local network.

Voice recordings (RECORD_AUDIO) are processed on-device by ML Kit face-presence detection and/or sent to the local muse gateway for voice chat. No audio is sent to remote servers or third parties. VoiceLoopService runs only with explicit consent.

Camera (CAMERA) is used ONLY for on-device face-presence detection in Presence Mode to arm hands-free listening when the user looks at the phone. No frames are stored or transmitted. ML Kit runs fully on-device. Camera is optional hardware (android:required="false").

data_shared.purpose: Core MUSE functionality — all processing happens locally

permissions.reason: Show local notifications for long-running work (jobs, approvals, emergency stop) and work-watcher polls
Required for all foreground services (HermesService, WorkWatchService, JarvisOverlayService, VoiceLoopService)
HermesService and WorkWatchService sync data with the local gateway
Reach the local muse gateway (default http://127.0.0.1:8765) over loopback/LAN. Never connects to remote AI providers.
In-app "install update" hands downloaded MUSE update APK to system package installer
JarvisOverlayService draws the floating avatar/presence indicator over other apps (owner-opted, consent-gated)
JarvisOverlayService runs as special-use foreground service for on-screen assistant avatar
VoiceLoopService runs microphone foreground service for hands-free voice loop
Voice input for chat and hands-free presence mode (owner-opted, consent-gated via mic_consent)
Connect to Bluetooth headsets for voice loop audio I/O
Device control (JarvisAccessibilityService) queries installed packages to launch apps/perform actions
On-device face-presence detection for Presence Mode (owner-opted, consent-gated via camera_attention_enabled). No frames stored/transmitted. android:required="false".

services.name: HermesService
services.purpose: Background sync with local muse gateway; posts local notifications for jobs/approvals

services.name: WorkWatchService
services.purpose: Polls cockpit for long-running work state changes; self-stops when idle

services.name: JarvisOverlayService
services.purpose: Floating avatar/presence indicator over other apps (owner-opted, overlay_consent required)

services.name: VoiceLoopService
services.purpose: Hands-free voice loop for wake-word and voice chat (mic_consent required)

services.name: JarvisAccessibilityService
services.purpose: Performs taps/swipes, launches apps for device control (accessibility_consent required)

services.name: ObservatoryWallpaperService
services.purpose: Live wallpaper rendering MUSE's real network graph (opt-in)
